snippet.title: 🎣 Dreadline: Net Quota – Influencer Callout Trailer
snippet.description:
💀 Fish or die. This chaotic 6-player co-op horror fishing game is launching in Steam Early Access on June 16, 2025 — and we want YOU to help shape it.

Think cursed sea monsters, screaming crewmates, ridiculous hats, and a fishing quota that might just kill you.

📣 Content creators, this one’s made for you:
🎥 Built for chaos, clips, and cursed co-op fails
🧢 Get a FREE exclusive in-game hat for creators
🎮 Need more keys for your squad? Just ask!
🎧 Want to fish with the devs? Hit us up on Discord!

🚨 Steam Next Fest demo is live from June 9–16
🎮 Try the game, and if you love the madness, support us in Early Access and help shape what’s next.

👉 Request your key now on Keymailer
https://www.keymailer.co/g/games/b82c39e6
🎮 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576880/Dreadline_Net_Quota/
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/fNxqDr6yha

#DreadlineNQ #FishingHorror #IndieGame #SteamNextFest #EarlyAccess
